newsitem.title: USA: Young 439 MW N.D. power unit seen back Friday.
newsitem.headline: Young 439 MW N.D. power unit seen back Friday.

text.p: Minnkota Power Coopertive said the 439 megawatt Milton Young coal-fired power unit 2 in Center, N.D., was likely to return to service Friday following boiler repairs.
The unit was taken off line on Nov 16 for the repairs, and was expected to return to service on Nov 22, a company spokeswoman said.
Minnkota operates the two Young units, which are held by various owners.
The 235 megawatt Young unit 1 was operating normally, the spokeswoman said.
